newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Vitarich says merging two subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: Vitarich says merging two subsidiaries.

text.p: Philippine poultry firm Vitarich Corp said on Tuesday it will merge two subsidiaries Breeder Master Inc (BMI) and Philippine American Poultry Breeders Inc (PAPBI) with the former as the surviving company.
Vitarich informed the Philippine Stock Exchange that the merger will "consolidate their operations, optimize the use of their resources, achieve tax efficiencies and maximize profitability."
After the merger, Vitarich will have 80.1 percent equity stake in BMI with 19.9 percent held by U.S. firm Cobb Ventres International.
At present, Vitarich has 80.1 percent stake in BMI and 84 percent in PAPBI while the rest of the shares are owned by Cobb Ventres. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418936 fax 8176267
